turns: 12; I wrote `e2e/api/generated/REV-05.spec.ts` with one test, tagged `@REV-05`. It passes with `npx playwright test --project=api api/generated/REV-05.spec.ts`, and `npx tsc --noEmit` exits 0. No other file was changed.

The test signs in as the reviewer and uses `factory.vendorInReview()` to set up a vendor with three pending extractions. It approves each extraction through `POST /api/extractions/{id}/decision` and expects 200 for each. It then checks that `GET /api/vendors/{id}` returns `status: "approved"` and that the vendor's audit trail contains `vendor.approved`.

One deviation from repo convention: `e2e/AGENTS.md` (rule PW-0) says approval tests should only check for a 2xx and leave status and audit checks to the backend suite. I followed your scenario instead, since it names both assertions. If you'd rather follow PW-0, those two checks should move to the backend tests.
